subject: Asteron RFP: request for above-standard Hosted API concession
messages:
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Cc: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 14 Sep 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: deeper Hosted API concession for Asteron (RFP response)

Marcus / Karthik —

Asteron pushed an updated RFP this morning and they want final commercial terms by EOD Friday. They’re a strategic win for Q3 — pilot with strong probability to expand to production in H1. Highlights:
- 18M tokens/mo projected in year 1, ramping to 50M by month 12 (attached forecast).
- 12-month committed term, potential extension to 24 months if we get a preferred vendor slot.
- They’ve got competing bids (two hypers) offering aggressive token pricing; our standard Hosted API pricing will put us out of contention.

Request: approve a concession of 28% off list Hosted API unit price for a 12-month commit (net effective rate in attached pricing matrix). This is >20% so per process I need exec sign-off.

Why it’s strategic: Asteron is connected to a major payer partner and getting this reference could unlock multiple introductions across their network. We also gain a potential marketplace placement in their partner catalog.

Attachments: asteron_usage_forecast_q3q4.csv, deal_summary_Asteron.pdf, redwood_pricing_matrix.xlsx

Asking for quick review — happy to jump on a call.

Thanks,
Ben
Senior Account Executive
Redwood Inference
From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
To: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 14 Sep 2026 10:03:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: Request: deeper Hosted API concession for Asteron (RFP response)

Mina / Karthik — forwarding Ben’s ask. I’ve reviewed the forecast and commercials. Quick context: this is an outbound-sourced Asteron RFP; Ben has the reference conversation and we think there’s upside in marketplace positioning.

Budget ask: 28% off list for 12 months. Tradeoffs I propose if we approve: 12-month minimum commit, usage-based clawback on early termination, mandatory quarterly business reviews, and marketing reference language in the contract.

Can we get a senior sign-off on the concession and confirm any finance/legal conditions we should include in the offer? Ben, I’ll be available 11–12 for a quick sync if helpful.

— Marcus
Director, Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference
From: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.ai>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 14 Sep 2026 12:18:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Request: deeper Hosted API concession for Asteron (RFP response)

Thanks Marcus —
A few quick questions before I sign off:
1) Net revenue impact vs. baseline over the 12-month term (include churn assumptions).
2) Will the 28% be fixed across all usage tiers or a blended effective rate?
3) Any carve-outs for overage or bursts?
4) Legal: are we comfortable with the proposed marketing/reference clause? Do we need a limited logo-use window or approval right?

Karthik, can you run a quick margin/IRR calc and confirm the recommendation? Ben — please attach any notes from legal on the marketing ask and a short bullet on the competitive bids (who/what price band).

Mina
VP, Global Sales
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 14 Sep 2026 15:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Fwd: Request: deeper Hosted API concession for Asteron (RFP response)

Mina — quick model, attached in-line summary from the pricing matrix.
- Baseline ARR (12mo at list): $420,000
- Revenue at 28% concession (12mo): $302,400
- Estimated gross margin after infra and support allocations: 45% (vs baseline 58%)
- Customer lifetime: conservative 24 months (we value future expansion) — NPV net positive with 24mo extension, marginal on 12mo only.

Recommendation: approve concession at 28% on condition of (1) 12-month non-cancellable minimum commit, (2) overage priced at list (no concession), (3) 30-day ramp credit only for month 1, (4) include marketing/reference limited to 6 months post-deal and subject to legal approval. This preserves upside and reduces downside risk.

If we want to be more conservative, we can offer 22% with a firm 18-month commit; that would keep margin closer to 50% while still being competitive.

Karthik
Head of Deal Desk
From: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.ai>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
Cc: Legal <legal@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 14 Sep 2026 17:03:00 -0700
Subject: APPROVED: Asteron Hosted API concession (28%) — conditional sign-off

Ben — approved for 28% off list Hosted API pricing for AST-2026-047 with the following conditions (please reflect in the SOW and SPA):
- 12-month minimum non-cancellable committed spend (numbers and monthly floors per attached forecast).
- All overage usage billed at list price (no discount).
- Early termination triggers pro-rata recapture of discount (clawback) calculated on realized tokens to date.
- Marketing/reference and logo usage limited to 6 months and subject to Legal approval; Legal to provide standard language.
- Contract to include quarterly business reviews and a renewal negotiation window at month 9.

CC Legal: please draft the limited reference clause and the discount clawback language. Karthik: update the pricing sheet and return clean execution docs to Ben. Marcus: coordinate the customer touchpoint for reference approvals.

Congratulations team — move quickly on the RFP response.

Mina Haddad
VP, Global Sales
Redwood Inference
